cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A directs immediate action under successive alleged secret goals whenever the prior action fails.
confusable: Unlike merely claiming the same plan succeeded, A changes the mission itself from waking to listening to breath control.
comparison: A map and dark wall differ from a ship radio and rejection rehearsal.
seedUse: The seed explicitly performs each new action and claims decision authority, making S01 control of the changing mission concrete.
